author: poojaranjan
content:
**Glamsterdam Meta EIP-7773 to `Review` **
I’m happy to share that all Glamsterdam SFI EIPs are now in `Review` status, and the [PR](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11855) to move EIP-7773 from `Draft` to `Review` is ready.

However, the recent merge of [PR #12116](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12116/changes/313e3bf94832917acab770a7bc0ea644562d12ab) has introduced a new blocker. The PR adds a “Mascot” subsection under Specification that references [EIP-8066](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8066), which is currently in `Draft`.

Firstly, I may be missing something, but I don’t recall an ACD decision to include the upgrade mascot in the Meta EIP, nor could I find this as a requirement in the existing guidelines for upgrade Meta EIPs. If there is a decision or documentation around this, I’d appreciate it being shared.

Secondly, as per the process, the bot will allow the status change only when all referenced EIPs have reached `Review.` If the decision is to include the mascot in the hard fork Meta EIP, may I please request the author of EIP-8066 ( <@365300888354422794> ) to advance the proposal? This would, however, delay EIP-7773’s progress when we should soon be moving toward `Last Call`.

I’d therefore request the authors of EIP-7773 ( <@552133098075193354> <@539495253418180618> <@415548822983278593> <@731289513942450317> <@199561711278227457> ) to share their preference: 
(a) keep the mascot and EIP-8066 in the document and wait for it to advance, or
(b) remove the reference and proceed with EIP-7773 to Review.

I’m happy to update the PR accordingly.
